dialog.title: Import data
dialog.description: Import a file exported from another password manager. The file is read and parsed on this computer and its content never leaves the app.

source.heading: Choose the source and file format

bitwardenJson.label: Bitwarden (JSON)
bitwardenJson.hint: Export as .json and do not choose the encrypted export. Logins, secure notes, cards, identities, SSH keys, folders, TOTP and custom fields can be imported.

bitwardenCsv.label: Bitwarden (CSV)
bitwardenCsv.hint: Contains only logins and secure notes. Use the JSON export for cards and identities.

browserCsv.label: Browser passwords (CSV)
browserCsv.hint: Password files exported from Chrome, Edge or Firefox. Logins only.

keepassxcCsv.label: KeePassXC (CSV)
keepassxcCsv.hint: Export as CSV in KeePassXC. Includes groups and TOTP.

plaintextWarning.title: The export file is plain text
plaintextWarning.description: It contains all of your passwords. Delete it as soon as the import is done.

preview.heading: Import preview
preview.description: Check the details below. Nothing is written until you choose Confirm import.
preview.notImportedHint: A list is shown when the import finishes.

duplicatePolicy.heading: What should happen to duplicates?
duplicatePolicy.description: Entries count as duplicates only when name, account and URL are all the same. They are compared with the entries that existed before the import.

deleteWarning.title: Delete the export file
deleteWarning.description: The export file is plain text and contains all of your passwords. The import is done and you no longer need it.

notImported.heading: Content that was not imported ({count})
notImported.truncated: Showing the first {shown} items. Save the list as a text file to see all of it.

report.title: List of content that was not imported

reasons.type-unsupported: This app has no matching entry type, so the whole entry was skipped
reasons.name-invalid: The name is empty or longer than 100 characters, so the whole entry was skipped
reasons.field-too-long: A field is longer than its limit, so the whole entry was skipped
reasons.row-malformed: The number of columns in this row does not match the header, so it was skipped
reasons.favorite-unsupported: Marked as a favorite in the source, which this app does not support
reasons.reprompt-unsupported: The source asks for the master password again before showing it, which this app does not support
reasons.password-history-unsupported: The password history in the source was not imported
reasons.passkey-unsupported: The passkeys in the source were not imported
reasons.archived-unsupported: Archived in the source, imported as a normal entry
reasons.linked-field-unsupported: A linked custom field was not imported
reasons.totp-invalid: The TOTP could not be parsed and was dropped, the rest of the entry was imported
reasons.tag-limit-exceeded: An entry can have at most 10 tags, the extra ones were not imported
reasons.tag-name-invalid: The tag name is longer than 50 characters and was not imported
reasons.folder-name-truncated: The folder path is longer than 50 characters, so its last part is used as the name
reasons.custom-field-name-empty: A custom field has no name and was dropped
reasons.unparsable-field-line: A line in the custom fields is not in the form name: value and was not imported

dialog.title: Export data
dialog.description: Export the entries in the vault to a file saved at a location you choose. The file is created on this computer and its content never leaves the app.

native.label: Full app format (ZIP)
native.hint: Contains all entries, types, folders, tags, notes formats, TOTP, custom fields and attachments, and can be restored as is. Any unzip tool can open it.

bitwardenJson.label: Bitwarden (JSON)
bitwardenJson.hint: Most password managers can import it, handy for switching apps.

browserCsv.label: Browser passwords (CSV)
browserCsv.hint: Chrome format with only the entries that have an account and a password, handy for switching browsers or checking in a spreadsheet.

options.csvFormulaNotice: When opened in a spreadsheet app, values starting with = + - @ may be run as formulas. Open the file in a text editor instead.

scope.heading: What to export
scope.currentHint: The entries of the folder and tags selected in the sidebar and filtered by the search.
scope.checkedHint: The entries checked in the entry list.
scope.empty: There are no entries in this range.
scope.tooMany: At most {limit} entries can be exported at once. Narrow the range and export in batches.
scope.loadFailed: Could not count the export range. Close the dialog and try again.

content.heading: What to include
content.secrets: Include secret fields and TOTP keys
content.secretsHint: When off, secret fields such as passwords and TOTP keys are left blank in the file, and the file says so.
content.attachmentsHint: Attachments are put into the file as they are, which makes the file larger.

encryption.heading: Passphrase encryption
encryption.enable: Encrypt the export file with a passphrase
encryption.enableHint: Without encryption the file is plain text and contains every password.
encryption.hint: At least {minLength} characters. If you forget it the file cannot be recovered and this app cannot reset it, so keep it safe yourself.

error.tooShort: The passphrase needs at least {minLength} characters.

confirm.heading: Confirm the export
confirm.description: Check the content below, then choose "Export" and pick where to save.

plaintextWarning.title: The export file is plain text
plaintextWarning.description: The file contains every password and key in this range, and anyone who gets the file can read them. Keep it somewhere safe and delete it as soon as you are done.

confirm.acknowledge: I understand the export file is plain text and contains all passwords

encryptedNotice.title: A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered
encryptedNotice.description: The export file can only be opened with the passphrase you just set. If you forget it the content cannot be recovered and this app cannot reset it.

masterPassword.label: Master password
masterPassword.hint: An export hands over every credential, so enter the master password again to confirm it is you.

result.heading: Export finished

plaintextReminder.title: Keep the export file safe and delete it soon
plaintextReminder.description: The export file is plain text and contains all passwords. Delete it as soon as you are done, and do not upload it to cloud storage or send it to anyone.

encryptedReminder.title: Remember the encryption passphrase
encryptedReminder.description: The file cannot be opened without the passphrase, and a forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered.

onboarding.title: Set a master password
onboarding.description: The master password unlocks your data each time you open the app.
onboarding.forgetNotice: The master password is not stored. If you forget it, the 24 recovery words shown next are the only way to get your data back. Keep them safe.

error.notAcknowledged: Confirm that you understand that recovery needs the recovery words first.
error.systemUnavailable: The system cannot protect the data key, so you cannot skip. Set a master password.
error.unexpected: The operation failed. Close the app and try again.

skipConfirm.title: Skip the master password?
skipConfirm.description: Your data stays encrypted, but anyone who can sign in to this Windows account can open the app.

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.description: Enter your master password to open your data.

error.wrongPassword: The master password is incorrect. Try again.
error.unexpected: Unlock failed. Close the app and try again.

failure.title: Unable to open your data
failure.description: A data file is missing or damaged, or the system cannot open the protected key. Close the app and try again. Do not delete the vault folder in the data directory. If you saved your recovery words, you can restore with them.

recovery.title: Recovery key
recovery.usage: If you forget the master password or the key file is lost, choose 'Forgot master password' or 'Restore with recovery words' on the unlock page and enter these 24 words in order.
recovery.warning: These 24 words work like a master key: anyone who has them can bypass the master password and open all of your data. Keep them offline. Do not store them in this vault, do not send them with an email backup, and do not photograph or upload them. If the words leak, they cannot be replaced in this version; if you lose the words and forget the master password, your data cannot be recovered.

file.dialogTitle: Save recovery words as a text file

show.title: Save your recovery words
show.description: If you forget the master password or the key file is lost, these 24 words are the only way to get your data back. Save them now. You will be asked to re-enter 3 of them next.
show.noCopy: Copying to the clipboard is not offered, so other programs cannot read the words.

save.textFileWarning: A text file is plain text. Sync tools, backups and cloud drives will carry it along, so save it somewhere that is not synced.

words.description: Enter your 24 saved recovery words. Once they are verified you can set a new master password. Your existing data is not changed.
words.pasteHint: You can paste all 24 words into any box at once.

protection.title: Set new protection
